claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
The funding is intended to pay for a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD after the existing contract closes.
UTxO RPC defines a standardized interface for UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and provides SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.

The maintainer scope includes protobuf specification maintenance, SDK dependency updates, performance improvements, bug fixing, issue triage, contribution review, feedback-driven enhancements, public communication, and AI-friendly documentation resources.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language-specific SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and is open-source under Apache 2.0.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The requested withdrawal is claimed not to breach the 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

Intersect will administer the funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, specified on-chain addresses, admin and leadership roles, and an external Oversight Committee.

TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus 2025 Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC that is being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance program administered by Intersect through treasury smart contracts, with stated ecosystem adoption, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and prior TxPipe delivery history, but several delivery, budget, risk, alternative, and feasibility details remain thin or asserted.
